menu:41691450:1.text: Gruglins cannot be allowed to harm Holistone...
menu:41691450:1.source_cn: 不能让咕布林危害圣石镇……

menu:41691450:1.text: Gruglins cannot be allowed to harm Holistone...
menu:41691450:1.source_cn: 不能让咕布林危害圣石镇……

say:1:1060101001:1.text: There's been gruglins around Holistone. Be careful outside of town.
say:1:1060101001:1.source_cn: 最近咕布林频繁出没，进出圣石镇务必多加小心。

choice_prompt:2:1060101001.text: There's been gruglins around Holistone. Be careful outside of town.
choice_prompt:2:1060101001.source_cn: 最近咕布林频繁出没，进出圣石镇务必多加小心。

say:3:1060101002:1.text: Yes, so stay vigilant out there.
say:3:1060101002:1.male: Yes, so stay vigilant out there.
say:3:1060101002:1.female: Yes, so stay vigilant out there.

say:4:1060101004:1.text: Sadly, we don't have enough soldiers in Holistone to send everyone after the gruglins. We still need soldiers in the town for security reasons.
say:4:1060101004:1.source_cn: 说来惭愧，圣石镇可以调用的士兵不多，还要留下一批守卫镇...

say:5:1060101005:1.text: So, even with all the soldiers we've dispatched, we're not going to get rid of all of them in one go.
say:5:1060101005:1.source_cn: 所以，即便是派出了那么多士兵，恐怕也不能一口气把他们全...

say:6:1060101006:1.text: Dura above, I wish we had more help here in Holistone...
say:6:1060101006:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，要是有人能帮帮圣石镇就好了……

choice_prompt:7:1060101006.text: Dura above, I wish we had more help here in Holistone...
choice_prompt:7:1060101006.source_cn: 艾雅在上，要是有人能帮帮圣石镇就好了……

say:8:1060101007:1.text: What? Really?! Has the goddess answered my prayers...?
say:8:1060101007:1.source_cn: 哎？！真的吗？\n难道女神真的听到了我的愿望……？
say:8:1060101007:1.male: What? Really?! Has the goddess answered my prayers...?
say:8:1060101007:1.female: What? Really?! Has the goddess answered my prayers...?

say:9:1060101008:1.text: Whatever the reason, thanks for the helping hand.
say:9:1060101008:1.source_cn: 不管怎么说，谢谢您愿意伸出援手。
say:9:1060101008:1.male: Whatever the reason, thanks for the helping hand.
say:9:1060101008:1.female: Whatever the reason, thanks for the helping hand.

say:10:1060101009:1.text: Gruglins usually lurk around right on the edge of town. Keep going down this road, and you'll see.
say:10:1060101009:1.source_cn: 咕布林平时就出没于镇子周围，沿着这条路一直往前走就能看到了。

say:11:1060101010:1.text: If you could clear them, on behalf of all of us in Holistone, I'll make it well worth your while!
say:11:1060101010:1.source_cn: 如果您能清除他们，我一定会代表圣石镇，为您送上丰厚的报酬！
say:11:1060101010:1.male: If you could clear them, on behalf of all of us in Holistone, I'll make it well worth your while!
say:11:1060101010:1.female: If you could clear them, on behalf of all of us in Holistone, I'll make it well worth your while!

choice:7:0:1.text: What a coincidence! I can help.
choice:7:0:1.male: What a coincidence! I can help.
choice:7:0:1.female: What a coincidence! I can help.

choice:2:0:1.text: Have there been a lot of gruglins?
choice:2:0:1.male: Have there been a lot of gruglins?
choice:2:0:1.female: Have there been a lot of gruglins?

say:13:1060101003:1.text: Some soldiers have been sent to deal with this.
say:13:1060101003:1.male: Some soldiers have been sent to deal with this.
say:13:1060101003:1.female: Some soldiers have been sent to deal with this.

choice:2:1:2.text: Is someone taking care of this?
choice:2:1:2.male: Is someone taking care of this?
choice:2:1:2.female: Is someone taking care of this?

say:0:1060102001:0.text: That seems to be all of them. I'll go back and tell the soldier that they've been taken care of.
say:0:1060102001:0.source_cn: 看起来没有其他咕布林了，回去和看守镇门的士兵说一声吧。
say:0:1060102001:0.male: That seems to be all of them. I'll go back and tell the soldier that they've been taken care of.
say:0:1060102001:0.female: That seems to be all of them. I'll go back and tell the soldier that they've been taken care of.

say:1:1060103001:1.text: I heard from the other soldiers that you took care of all the gruglins. You're a hero!
say:1:1060103001:1.source_cn: 我听回来的士兵说，您毫不费力地就解决了所有咕布林，真是...
say:1:1060103001:1.male: I heard from the other soldiers that you took care of all the gruglins. You're a hero!
say:1:1060103001:1.female: I heard from the other soldiers that you took care of all the gruglins. You're a hero!

choice_prompt:2:1060103001.text: I heard from the other soldiers that you took care of all the gruglins. You're a hero!
choice_prompt:2:1060103001.source_cn: 我听回来的士兵说，您毫不费力地就解决了所有咕布林，真是英勇啊！
choice_prompt:2:1060103001.male: I heard from the other soldiers that you took care of all the gruglins. You're a hero!
choice_prompt:2:1060103001.female: I heard from the other soldiers that you took care of all the gruglins. You're a hero!

say:3:1060103002:1.text: Stop being so modest! Holistone is lucky to have you protecting us!
say:3:1060103002:1.source_cn: 别谦虚了！有您这么厉害的人出手相助，是我和圣石镇的荣幸。
say:3:1060103002:1.male: Stop being so modest! Holistone is lucky to have you protecting us!
say:3:1060103002:1.female: Stop being so modest! Holistone is lucky to have you protecting us!

say:4:1060103004:1.text: I've prepared your reward, but I have one more request.
say:4:1060103004:1.source_cn: 报酬我已经为您准备好了。除此之外，我还有一个小小的请求。
say:4:1060103004:1.male: I've prepared your reward, but I have one more request.
say:4:1060103004:1.female: I've prepared your reward, but I have one more request.

choice_prompt:5:1060103004.text: I've prepared your reward, but I have one more request.
choice_prompt:5:1060103004.source_cn: 报酬我已经为您准备好了。除此之外，我还有一个小小的请求。
choice_prompt:5:1060103004.male: I've prepared your reward, but I have one more request.
choice_prompt:5:1060103004.female: I've prepared your reward, but I have one more request.

say:6:1060103005:1.text: Many people in Holistone and the nearby villages are in need of help. We try to assist them as much as we can, but our resources and manpower are limited.
say:6:1060103005:1.source_cn: 圣石镇和附近的村庄里，有很多居民需要帮助。虽然我们会尽...

say:7:1060103006:1.text: If it's not too much trouble, would you mind helping them out? I've been told that you will be fairly compensated.
say:7:1060103006:1.source_cn: 如果您方便的话，可以顺手帮他们一把。他们不会在酬劳上亏...
say:7:1060103006:1.male: If it's not too much trouble, would you mind helping them out? I've been told that you will be fairly compensated.
say:7:1060103006:1.female: If it's not too much trouble, would you mind helping them out? I've been told that you will be fairly compensated.

say:9:1060103003:1.text: It's a shame that I couldn't be there to see you in action.
say:9:1060103003:1.source_cn: 没能亲眼目睹您的风姿，真是我的遗憾。
say:9:1060103003:1.male: It's a shame that I couldn't be there to see you in action.
say:9:1060103003:1.female: It's a shame that I couldn't be there to see you in action.

choice:2:1:2.text: I did what I had to do.
choice:2:1:2.male: I did what I had to do.
choice:2:1:2.female: I did what I had to do.
